messages:
maria: Quick debrief from the EU failover postmortem — collecting owners for remediation items and timelines. Key patterns: transient BGP route flaps that caused regional routing ambiguity, snapshot restore failures when metadata files are missing, and unclear game-day handoff steps. Posting a short action list; please claim items or flag timeline concerns.

kevin: I can take the multi-region routing piece. Action: audit route advertisements + add guardrails to the routing controller. Target: small PR + canary by EOW.

sasha: I'll own the restore runbook rewrite. Plan: flatten steps, add explicit verification steps, and include a recovery checklist for ops. Will start draft tomorrow, aim for review in 5 days.

anil: I'll build an automated snapshot verification job — checksum + restore dry-run on a small volume. Proposed cadence: nightly for EU snapshots, weekly for global. ETA: 2 weeks.

deploy-bot: scheduled: /reminder set "DR runbook dry-run" at 2026-03-13 09:00 PT in #incidents :calendar:

maria: Good — adding temporary fallbacks: ensure traffic can shift to warm-standby region within 3m. Kevin, scope includes controller timeout tuning + a fallback policy.

kevin: sgtm. I'll add a config flag that forces synchronous route withdraws during failover tests. Quick note: we should avoid flushing all routes at once — cause spikes.

ops-runbooks: Proposed runbook checklist (compact):
- Preconditions: snapshot age < 24h, route table verified.
- Step 1: Quiesce writes (api-proxy -> maintenance).
- Step 2: Snapshot restore command: ``./restore --snapshot $ID --env eu --verify``
- Step 3: Run healthchecks: /healthz, token-validation, sample inference.
- Rollback: reattach previous routes and rollback snapshot mount.

sasha: embedding the above checklist into runbook draft. Also adding a "what to watch" section with the recurring signals we saw (route flaps, metadata mismatch, slow cache warm-up).

maria: We should also create a small metrics dashboard: "DR readiness" showing last successful restore, avg route convergence time, snapshot verification pass rate. Who can take dashboard?

anil: I can add the restore verification metric and an alert if verification fails 2x in 24h.

kevin: I'll add route convergence metric. Need an SLO entry so infra knows expected convergence time.

maria: Owners recap + timelines:
- Multi-region routing guardrails: kevin — PR + canary by 2026-03-05.
- Restore runbook rewrite: sasha — draft by 2026-03-01, review by 2026-03-06.
- Snapshot verification automation: anil — staging job by 2026-03-08.
- DR readiness dashboard: anil + kevin — baseline by 2026-03-10.

maria: Proposed game day (dry-run) Wed 2026-03-11 09:00 PT — short window, aim to exercise restore + routing switch. Can everyone hold that slot?

kevin: +1

sasha: +1, will have runbook draft ready for pre-read.

anil: +1, will have verification job running in staging.

maria: Thanks all. I'll open a short GH project with these items and milestones, and ping owners for status updates in weekly incident sync. If anything slips, ping here with updated ETA. :thumbsup:

kevin: minor note — we should add a post-game checklist to capture lessons quickly (one-pager). I'll draft that after the dry-run.

sasha: Also adding a section in runbook for "unexpected partial restores" — how to triage cache mismatches.

maria: Perfect. I'll put the game-day invite and GH project link in this thread when created.

deploy-bot: Reminder: DR dry-run scheduled in 18 days.

kevin: Thanks — keeping this tight helps reduce recurrence. :rocket:
